original_prompt: FRAME FORMAT: Deliver a single 512 x 512 pixel game UI sprite, even dimensions, fixed centered pivot (256,256), uniform proportional scale, transparent margins for the whole emblem. Actual transparent background. Asset type: finished production alert-sign sprite for Bullets of Fury, a richly detailed industrial pixel-art vertical arcade shooter. Create a major quality upgrade over an old flat triangular ALERT sign: a formidable, finely crafted triangular danger emblem in dark gunmetal, machined silver beveled armor, layered inset rails, tiny rivets and segmented red/amber warning lamps integrated into its frame. Large unmistakable luminous exclamation symbol in the center (thick vertical tapered bar plus separate square dot), hot ivory/amber center with red emissive edges, surrounded by a dark red-black inset so the symbol reads immediately even when displayed at 210 pixels tall. Strong clean triangular silhouette; sophisticated stepped metal bevels and sharp black outlines, asymmetrical small mechanical details balanced around a symmetric main silhouette. Crisp hand-pixeled arcade sprite shading, controlled 2–4 pixel clusters, metallic highlights, beautifully authored red light details; clean transparent cutout, not a blurry 3D render, not vector clip art. Frontal orthographic view, no perspective tilt. Fit the complete emblem in approximately x48..464 and y40..472, centered; no clipping of the outer metal corners or glow. Keep any exterior red glow very tight to the rim, no smoke, no bloom cloud, no black rectangle, no environment. TEXT: absolutely no words, labels, numbers, logos or watermark; only the exclamation hazard SYMBOL. No upward arrow, no skull, no wings, no characters, no decorative text banner. One standalone finished emblem only, no presentation board or sprite sheet.
revision_prompt: FRAME FORMAT: Deliver one complete game alert UI sprite on a 768 x 640 pixel transparent canvas, even dimensions, fixed center pivot (384,320), one proportional scale, transparent margins around the whole design. Edit the supplied newly generated alert emblem. Preserve its specific beautiful gunmetal/silver layered triangular armor, black outlines, red/amber segmented warning lamps, luminous exclamation symbol, crisp pixel-art metallic shading and frontal view. Add a wide attached dark-metal warning panel underneath the triangle, using the same silver bevels, inset black-red display, armored corners and red light strips. Recompose the triangle smaller above the attached panel so both are fully visible and balanced as a single premium arcade shooter alert graphic; no clipping. Put this EXACT text into the panel, perfectly spelled, without any extra copy: "Warning: Critical Enemy Approaching!". Typography: chunky highly legible arcade pixel lettering, warm ivory/amber against nearly black, ample clear space around every letter, no glow obscuring glyphs. Use two centered lines, first "Warning:" and second "Critical Enemy Approaching!"; preserve these words, capitalization and punctuation exactly. Make the panel wide enough to keep the entire second line on one line and readable when the complete asset is shown about 340 pixels wide. No other labels, no logo, no additional words, no arrows, no scene or spaceship, no presentation mockup. Actual transparent background outside the metal silhouette; no black rectangular background. Keep the existing exclamation and metal rendering quality; the new warning panel is the only new design element.
